title: Permission before proof
lines: Your idea needs proof to win support, but producing proof needs support first.
The Permission Paradox proposes a way to test ideas caught inside that circle.

title: Two reasonable viewpoints
lines: Inventors imagine something new; reviewers want evidence that it will work.
Both have reasons, and a promising idea can disappear between them.

title: The smallest useful test
lines: AI makes the mismatch sharper by producing proposals faster than institutions can test them.
The book asks how we might test an unfamiliar idea before accepting or dismissing it.
